title: Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS)
description: Break/fix labs for Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS)

items.title: 1.3 Properly set up Ingress objects with TLS
2.3 Understand and implement isolation techniques (multi-tenancy, sandboxed containers, etc.)
4.2 Understand your supply chain (e.g. SBOM, CI/CD, artifact repositories)
4.3 Secure your supply chain (permitted registries, sign and validate artifacts, etc.)
5.1 Minimize host OS footprint (reduce attack surface)
5.2 Using least-privilege identity and access management
5.3 Minimize external access to the network
5.4 Appropriately use kernel hardening tools such as AppArmor, seccomp
6.1 Perform behavioral analytics to detect malicious activities
6.3 Investigate and identify phases of attack and bad actors within the environment
6.4 Ensure immutability of containers at runtime
6.5 Use Kubernetes audit logs to monitor access
